== Notes ==
* This skill triggers when the target [[Fail#Skills that have an effect when an attack fails to hit|fails to hit]]. [[Block]]ing with a skill, [[Line of sight|dodging a ranged attack, or even using the terrain to avoid being hit]] by a [[ranged attack]] will trigger the energy gain.
* Great synergy with other effects that further increase the chance to miss, notably the [[Blind]] condition, and to a lesser extent the hexes [[Blurred Vision]], [[Calculated Risk]], [[Price of Failure]] and [[Reckless Haste]].
* Combine with [[Distortion]] for good blocking and energy management.
* As with blocking, "missed" hexes combine multiplicatively and not additively. Thus, a foe hexed with both [[Reckless Haste]] and Spirit of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks.
